disposition_reason: Hydroponic dosing of rice seedlings with germanic acid; reports lesion dose-response, heritability and a twofold range in leaf germanium accumulation (figure only); no food occurrence data.

study.design: plant genetics: hydroponic germanium exposure with QTL and genome-wide association mapping
study.method: Total germanium in dried shoot tissue by ICP-MS (Agilent 7500) after microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; rhodium internal standard
study.qa: Certified reference material and blank digests (p. 5)

unresolved: Leaf germanium concentrations appear only in Fig 4; the text value of about 12 mg/g (p. 11) was not recorded because the unit and figure reading could not be verified.
non_numeric_findings: Germanium is taken up by plant roots as Ge(OH)4 by the same mechanism as silicon (p. 2, background).
Lesion cover correlated with leaf germanium (R2 = 22.8%, P = 0.022) across 19 cultivars (p. 9).
